Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.27.0 integrates the original Stormhammer and separate Skywrath V2 awakened form with the v0.26.0 helicopter presentation release. Stormhammer includes original models, authored UV/glow/effect textures, three PCM sounds, exactly three awakened Android HUD skills, server-authoritative skill sequencing, and synchronized presentation package 242; its base form remains independent. Existing helicopter flight, seats, network paths and lifecycle-managed audio are preserved. Android rendering, touch layout, performance and real multiplayer synchronization remain pending device verification.
